title: tmuxp Workspace
description: Schema for tmuxp workspace files (.tmuxp.yaml / .tmuxp.json). See https://tmuxp.git-pull.com/configuration/

session_name.description: Name of the tmux session. Used for session creation and detecting existing sessions. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

start_directory.description: Default working directory for the session. Relative paths are relative to the workspace file location. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

before_script.description: Path to a script to run before building the session. Must be executable (chmod +x). A non-zero exit code aborts session creation. CWDs into the session-level start_directory. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

shell_command_before.description: Command(s) run before each pane's shell_command in all windows. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

suppress_history.description: When true (default), shell commands are prefixed with a space to suppress them from shell history (requires HISTCONTROL=ignorespace for bash, HIST_IGNORE_SPACE for zsh). Set false to allow commands into history.

environment.description: Environment variables to set for the session. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution in values.

global_options.description: Server-wide tmux options (e.g. default-shell, default-command). Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution in values.

options.description: Session-level tmux options (e.g. main-pane-height). Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution in values.

plugins.description: List of tmuxp plugin module names to load.

windows.description: Ordered list of windows to create in the session.

environment_map.description: Key/value pairs of environment variable names and their string values.

shell_command_before.description: One or more shell commands to run before the pane's main commands. Can be a single string, a list of strings, or a list of command objects.

command_object.description: A command with optional execution control.

cmd.description: The shell command to send to the pane.

enter.description: Whether to send Enter after the command. Default true. Set false to type the command without executing it (experimental, added in 1.10.0).

sleep_before.description: Seconds to wait before sending this command (experimental, added in 1.10.0). Blocking.

sleep_after.description: Seconds to wait after sending this command (experimental, added in 1.10.0). Blocking.

shell_command_value.description: The shell_command for a pane. Can be a single string, a list of strings/command-objects, or null for a blank pane.

oneOf.description: A single shell command string. An empty string sends a carriage return.
No command; opens a blank pane.
A sequence of commands to send in order.

pane.description: A pane inside a window. Can be a blank/shorthand value or a full pane object.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: a bare shell command string, or one of the blank-pane sentinels ('pane', 'blank', '') or null.

shell_command.description: Command(s) to run in this pane.

shell.description: Path to the shell or application to start for this pane (e.g. /usr/bin/python3). Overrides the window-level window_shell for this pane.

start_directory.description: Working directory for this pane. Relative paths are appended to the session-level start_directory if not absolute.

focus.description: If true, this pane will be focused (selected) when the window is first shown.

suppress_history.description: Override the session/window suppress_history setting for this pane.

enter.description: Whether to send Enter after all shell_command entries. Default true. Set false to skip Enter for the whole pane (experimental, added in 1.10.0).

sleep_before.description: Seconds to wait before sending any commands to this pane (experimental, added in 1.10.0). Blocking.

sleep_after.description: Seconds to wait after sending all commands to this pane (experimental, added in 1.10.0). Blocking.

environment.description: Environment variables to set for this pane. Requires tmuxp >= 1.19.

window_name.description: Name of the window. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

layout.description: tmux layout for this window. Standard values: even-horizontal, even-vertical, main-horizontal, main-vertical, tiled. Custom layout strings are also accepted.

panes.description: List of panes to create in this window.

start_directory.description: Working directory for all panes in this window. A relative path is appended to the session-level start_directory. An absolute path takes full precedence.

focus.description: If true, this window will be the active window after the session loads.

window_index.description: Explicit tmux window index to assign. Windows without this field are assigned the lowest available index.

window_shell.description: Shell or application to start for all panes in this window (e.g. /usr/bin/python2). Can be overridden per-pane with pane-level shell.

shell_command_before.description: Commands to run before each pane's shell_command in this window. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

suppress_history.description: Override the session-level suppress_history setting for all panes in this window.

options.description: tmux window options to set before panes are created (e.g. automatic-rename, main-pane-height). Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution in values.

options_after.description: tmux window options to set after all panes are created. Useful for synchronize-panes which should be enabled after individual pane commands have run.

environment.description: Environment variables to set for all panes in this window. Requires tmuxp >= 1.19.
